items.title: Air Force Caps Regular Season With Setback At New Mexico
items.summary: Air Force football dropped its regular season finale at New Mexico (10-2, 7-1 MW), 42-19, Friday afternoon at University Stadium in Albuquerque, NM.  The Falcons cap the regular season with a 9-3 overall record and 5-3 mark in MW play.

items.title: Offensive line coach Steed Lobotzke nominated for Broyles Award as nation’s top assistant coach
items.summary: Offensive line coach Steed Lobotzke is among the nominees for the Broyles Award as the nation's top assistant coach. The organization released the nominees for its 31st award earlier today.

items.title: Sophomore OLB Connor Vasek named Mountain West Defensive Player of the Week for performance vs. UTEP
items.summary: Sophomore OLB Connor Vasek has been named Mountain West Defensive Player of the Week for his performance Air Force's 52-3 win over UTEP last week.

items.title: Air Force Hits On All Cylinders In 52-3 Win Over UTEP On Senior Night
items.summary: U.S. AIR FORCE ACADEMY, Colo. – Sophomore quarterback Evan Medders recorded the first multi-passing touchdown game of his career and the offense racked up 586 total yards of offense, leading Air Force to a 52-3 win over UTEP on senior night, Friday, Nov. 20, at Falcon Stadium, in Colorado Springs, Colo.

items.title: Air Force vs. UTEP: Know before you go
items.summary: Air Force hosts UTEP on Friday, Nov. 20, at 6 p.m. MT in Falcon Stadium. Stadium gates open two hours prior to kickoff, while the ticket office opens three hours ahead of kickoff. Early arrival is highly encouraged. Fans parking in lots 1-2 are asked to use the South Gate entrance while fans with parking in lots 4-6 are asked to use the North Gate.
